# apple_app_asset_library_placements (Data Source)

Lists the placements of an App Asset Library image or video.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app_asset_library_placements" "home" {
  image_id = apple_app_asset_library_image.home.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `image_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the image. Exactly one of `image_id` and `video_id` is required.
- `video_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the video.

### Read-Only

- `placements` (Attributes List) The placements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--placements))

<a id="nestedatt--placements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `placements`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the placement.
- `placement_group` (String) Device family the placement targets.
- `placement_type` (String) Where the asset shows.
- `state` (String) State of the placement.
